scenario: Runtime project persistence rejects invalid or incomplete input without replacing the current complete snapshot.
input: An invalid logical project or asset identifier, an oversized payload, or an incomplete snapshot is submitted to the Runtime API.
visibleError: The Runtime returns a stable path-free validation or payload-limit error.
recovery: The previous complete project snapshot remains visible and the Runtime can continue serving valid requests.
sideEffects: No partial project, history, or asset record is published from invalid input.
